high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for Thai Mangosteen from Gourmet Garden India. The ad is sponsored and features a close-up photograph of the fruit. The mangosteen is shown both whole and cut open, revealing its distinctive white, star-shaped flesh surrounded by a deep purple rind. The text on the image reads: "Thai Mangosteen - Gourmet Garden India" "Get Certified Organic Fruits Delivered Straight To Your Home! Shop from..." The ad includes a call-to-action button labeled "Shop Now" at the bottom, encouraging viewers to purchase the product.
